compute.scope: GEMM main terms per the workbook R-column (2*M*N*Q); attention QK/PV on s^2; no softmax/conv-state/elementwise counts.

memory.activation_estimate_kind: Sum of named forward tensors per the workbook N-column (x2B; logits x4B); not measured peak.
memory.cache_scope: MLA latent KV per MLA layer (kv_lora + rope dims, bf16); KDA conv states are not modeled in the workbook.

per_rank.note: Weights/gradients: dense modules ÷TP, routed experts ÷EP (row G68). Optimizer states ÷ total cards (row K66). Shared experts, latent mapping and gate are placed with the dense modules (÷TP).

training_breakdown.note: Whole-model training states; per_rank carries the sharded static memory for one card under the workbook mesh (rows G63/G68/K66). Activation memory and all-gather traffic are reported separately.

per_rank.note: Weights/gradients: dense modules ÷TP, routed experts ÷EP (row G68). Optimizer states ÷ total cards (row K66). Shared experts, latent mapping and gate are placed with the dense modules (÷TP).

notes: 10T Kimi is a planning extension derived from the workbook '10T Kimi 显存建模.xlsx' (sheets 10T-深度-v2 / 10T-宽度-v2); no official HF config is pinned.
Param totals reproduce the workbook I-column formula chain; the cached J55 on 深度-v2 predates the v2 MLA g_proj 补档 and is stale.
Optimizer states: AdamW 12 B/param (embedding + LM head), Muon 8 B/param (everything else); gradients 2 B; master weights 0.
Per-rank static memory: dense modules /TP, routed experts /EP, optimizer states /total cards (rows G63/G68/K66).
Dense layer (layer 0) carries no attention in 深度-v2 (mla+kda == moe_layers) and an MLA in 宽度-v2 (mla+kda == num_hidden_layers), mirroring the workbook counts.
All displayed GiB use 2^30 bytes. JSON carries raw bytes.
